PORTFOLIO REVIEW:

NEW OPPORTUNITY: DHR (Danaher) is the standout candidate. It sits at 42% of its 52w range (Stage 1-2 transition zone), UPTREND with an accelerating SMA50 slope (+5.4%), and is only +3.4% above its SMA50 — not overextended. Fundamentally, Danaher is a compounding machine: $4.3B FCF, $6.6B operating cash flow, PEG 1.29, and analyst EPS revisions trending higher (+2.2%). Earnings are 76 days out, removing near-term binary risk. The setup — basing in the lower half of its range with a recovering SMA50 slope and minimal SMA50 extension — is exactly the Weinstein Stage 1-2 pattern we seek.

All other top candidates either are too extended (APH 93%, CNC 89%, NSC 89%, STLD 89%, TROW 84%, TRV 86% of 52w range), have earnings imminent (JKHY 13d), or lack a clean enough technical setup. Disciplined pass on the rest. One quality trade > three mediocre ones.
